headline: Mobavenue AI Tech EGM to approve merger
summary: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd will hold an EGM on Nov 26, 2026, to approve the merger of its wholly owned subsidiary, Mobavenue Media Pvt Ltd, under Section 233.

headline: Cummins India Q2FY27 PAT falls 18% YoY
summary: Cummins India reported a 18.5% YoY decline in consolidated net profit to ₹507.17 crore for Q2FY27, despite revenue growth of 4% YoY.

headline: Hy-Tech Engineers Q2FY27: Net profit up 23% YoY
summary: Hy-Tech Engineers Ltd reported a 23.4% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹85.02 million. Revenue from operations grew 21.6% YoY to ₹585.57 million, driven by strong sales volumes.

headline: Robokidz adds 3 centres in Pune
summary: Robokidz Eduventures expands its Young Engineers Academy network with three new centres in Pune, strengthening its presence in Amanora, Viman Nagar, and Kharadi.

headline: Ausom Enterprise Q2FY27 Results
summary: Ausom Enterprise reports Q2FY27 standalone net profit of ₹118.28 lakh, up 130% YoY. Consolidated revenue surges to ₹848.84 crore.

headline: Mayur Leather Q2FY27 Results: Zero Revenue, Adverse Audit
summary: Mayur Leather Products Ltd reported zero operational revenue for Q2FY27. The auditor issued an adverse conclusion citing going concern doubts and missing records.

headline: Brigade Enterprises signs IFC deal for housing
summary: Brigade Enterprises enters Investment Framework Agreement with IFC to fund middle-income housing projects via subsidiary Venusta Ventures.

headline: Bharti Hexacom RTA shifts office
summary: Bharti Hexacom Limited announced the relocation of its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies, to a new Hyderabad address effective December 1, 2026.

headline: Shree Vasu Logistics Q2FY27 net profit jumps 318% YoY
summary: Shree Vasu Logistics reported a 318% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹508.41 lakh for Q2FY27, driven by 43% revenue growth in its 3PL segment.

headline: Ravindra Energy Q2FY27: Revenue up 80%, EBITDA rises
summary: Ravindra Energy reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,903.3 million, up 80% YoY. EBITDA rose to ₹531 million, while PAT declined to ₹190.4 million due to EV subsidiary losses.

headline: Zenith Steel Q2FY27 Results: Net Profit Down 52% YoY
summary: Zenith Steel Pipes & Industries reported a 52% YoY drop in net profit to ₹26.94 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue fell 15.8% YoY. Auditors issued a qualified opinion citing going concern doubts.

headline: Bajaj Electricals passes key resolutions via postal ballot
summary: Bajaj Electricals disclosed voting results for its August 2026 postal ballot. All four special resolutions, including ESOP expansion and executive remuneration revisions, passed with requisite majority on November 4, 2026.

headline: Kesar India Q2FY27 PAT jumps 1,735% to ₹18.17 crore
summary: Kesar India Limited reported a massive surge in standalone net profit for Q2FY27, driven by higher real estate revenue and a reversal of prior accounting adjustments.

headline: NCLT sanctions Narayana Hrudayalaya demerger
summary: NCLT Bengaluru approved the demerger of NH Integrated Care's clinical services into Narayana Hrudayalaya. No shares issued as consideration; effective April 1, 2025.

headline: Tokyo Plast Q2FY27 Results: Consolidated loss widens
summary: Tokyo Plast International posted a consolidated net loss of ₹238.32 lakh in Q2FY27, reversing from a profit. Standalone profit fell 45% YoY to ₹37.84 lakh as costs rose.
